name: UpdateAlertRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert contact group
parameters.name: contact_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically start the alert rule after it is generated. Default value: `false`.

`true`: Automatically starts the alert rule.
`false`: Does not automatically start the alert rule
parameters.help_zh:
生成报警规则后是否自动启动报警规则。默认为`false`。

`true`：自动启动报警规则
`false`：不自动启动报警规则
parameters.name: is_auto_start
